desc: Ideation and case analysis for unique middle mode (a+b>=2 always valid; a+b==1 needs 3 distinct non-x; a+b==0 never valid).
Implement the per-middle-index O(n^2) counting solution using incremental left/right frequency maps and modular combinations.
Brute-force cross-check on 5000 random small arrays (n=5..9, small value alphabet): 0 mismatches, plus structured edge cases passed.
Confirm performance/edge behavior at n=1000 (all equal, all distinct, alternating) is within O(n^2) with correct modular non-negative results.
